name: HTTP Request With Logger
purpose: Logs an HTTP request, response and cURL options from the HTTP module to the HTTPRequestLog table. The request Authorization header is replaced by "--hidden--". When running inside an open QBO record it clears QBO::id_Log to create the related log record, otherwise it creates a log record on the HTTPRequestLog layout.
writes:
QBO::id_Log#32 (step 16, current record; clearing it creates the related log record)
HTTPRequestLog::Request#3 (step 17, related via QBO)
HTTPRequestLog::Response#2 (step 18, related via QBO)
HTTPRequestLog::curl#4 (step 19, related via QBO)
HTTPRequestLog: new record (New Record/Request step 22)
HTTPRequestLog::Request#3 (step 23, new record)
HTTPRequestLog::Response#2 (step 24, new record)
HTTPRequestLog::curl#4 (step 25, new record)
open_question: secret (steps 8, 19, 25): only the Authorization header is masked; the cURL options, other headers, query strings (tokens, API key in URLs) and the full response body (which may hold access tokens) are stored unmasked in HTTPRequestLog. The log fills without limit; no purge here. The branch depends on the layout (Get(LayoutTableName)) and an open record state.
